note: Image Style Warmer pre-generates image style derivatives. Its entire persistent config is the config object image_style_warmer.settings with two sequence keys: initial_image_styles (styles built synchronously at request end via the service's destruct()) and queue_image_styles (styles built by the image_style_warmer_pregenerator cron QueueWorker). There is no per-field config. Medium/hard cases are grounded in that real config object and core image styles (thumbnail/medium/large exist by default). Introspection reads back which style is initial vs queued; execution sets the two lists and is verified against the live config.

evals.prompt: In the Drupal contrib module Image Style Warmer, what is the difference between the two lists of image styles you can configure, and how does each list get generated? Name the two config keys.
evals.expected_output: image_style_warmer.settings has initial_image_styles (generated synchronously at the end of the request, via the warmer service's destruct()) and queue_image_styles (pushed to the image_style_warmer_pregenerator queue and generated later by its cron QueueWorker).

evals.prompt: I enabled Image Style Warmer on a Drupal 11 site. Where is its settings page and which config object stores the chosen image styles?
evals.expected_output: Settings are at /admin/config/development/performance/image-style-warmer (route image_style_warmer.settings, under Configuration > Development > Performance, permission 'administer site configuration'), and the values are stored in the image_style_warmer.settings config object.

evals.prompt: I just added Image Style Warmer and configured some initial image styles, but there are already thousands of images on the site. How do I generate the derivatives for all the existing images without waiting for visitors?
evals.expected_output: Run the Drush command image-style-warmer:warm-up (alias isw:wu), which batches over every existing file and warms it with the initial_image_styles list. For queue_image_styles, run the image_style_warmer_pregenerator queue via cron or 'drush queue:run image_style_warmer_pregenerator'.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, Image Style Warmer is configured. Which image style is set to be generated in the background via the cron queue worker (not synchronously on upload)? Give the image style machine name.
evals.expected_output: The 'large' image style is in image_style_warmer.settings queue_image_styles, so it is generated by the image_style_warmer_pregenerator cron queue worker. (The 'thumbnail' style is in initial_image_styles and is generated synchronously on upload.)

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, Image Style Warmer is configured. Which image style is generated immediately (synchronously) when an image file is uploaded? Give the image style machine name.
evals.expected_output: The 'medium' image style is listed in image_style_warmer.settings initial_image_styles, so it is generated during the request when a file is saved.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure Image Style Warmer so that the 'medium' image style is generated immediately when an image is uploaded (synchronously), and the 'large' image style is generated later in the background via the cron queue worker. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In image_style_warmer.settings, initial_image_styles contains 'medium' and queue_image_styles contains 'large' (e.g. set both keys on the config object and save, or tick the checkboxes on the settings form).

evals.prompt: My Drupal site has Image Style Warmer installed. I want the small thumbnail version of every image to be built as soon as the image is uploaded, so pages never have to wait to create it. Set that up on the live site.
evals.expected_output: Add the 'thumbnail' image style to initial_image_styles in image_style_warmer.settings so it is generated synchronously on upload (via the settings form's Initial image styles checkboxes, or by setting the config key and saving).
